title: Multi-index order as an indicator sum
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\iota$ be a type with decidable equality, choose a distinguished element $z\in\iota$, and let $a:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\iota$. The number of positions $i$ for which $a(i)\ne z$, viewed as a real number, equals $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}\mathbf{1}_{a(i)\ne z}$.
